title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC +4.7% (24h) → ~$60,734; rebounding from $55K Nov 21 low; $61–62K resistance
GDP Q3 2nd est: 4.3% (vs 3.5% exp) — economy hot; Dec FOMC hike 94–98% priced
Jobless claims wk Nov 21: 189K (vs ~200K exp) — labor market tight
Durable goods Oct: +0.2% (vs +0.7% exp) — softer than expected
Switzerland spot BTC ETF live on SIX Exchange — first Swiss listed BTC spot product
